_comment: The Adjust tree screen (docs/architecture/adjust-tree.md section 5): the pure rules (adjustTree.helpers.js: building the tree, what a drop means, which units a search shows, which adjustments belong to a unit, the id of a unit just added), the data hook and its write routes (useAdjustTree.js), what each button, drop and Needs-attention fix writes (useAdjustTreeActions.js), the resolve state of the Adjust tree entry points (useTreeResolve.js), the one DndContext and the open/closed state of the tree (AdjustTreeView.jsx) and the parameter-form field choice (schemaFieldKind / enumOptions live in NewContextWizard.helpers.js, mutated by its own scope when it gets one). WHY: a drop that posts the wrong toParentId, a move into the unit's own subtree that is let through, or an Undo that takes back the wrong adjustments changes the organisation tree every consumer reads. Run: cd app/ui && npm run test:mutation:adjusttree. TEST INCLUDE traces the importers: the helper unit test, the hook tests, and the mounted page tests that drive the screen through the stubbed API. MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral excluded, matching the sibling configs. NOT YET MEASURED: break is deliberately absent until a first run measures a score.

mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AdjustTreePage: Composition shell: wires useAdjustTree, useAdjustTreeActions and the panes together. Its two decisions (selection falls back to the first top unit; read only without data.write.contexts or when the tree says canAdjust false) are asserted both ways by AdjustTreePage.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AdjustTreeHead: Presentational bar: the source line comes from sourceText() in adjustTree.helpers.js (mutated here); Refresh only on a generated tree for an editor is asserted both ways by AdjustTreePanels.mount.test.jsx.
Presentational row: marks, counts and the drop/selection classes come from unitMarks() / countText() in adjustTree.helpers.js (mutated here); the drag wiring is dnd-kit's, and what a drop means is resolveDrop(), mutated here and driven by AdjustTreeView.dnd.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AdjustTreeMemb: Presentational list of a unit's members read through useFetch; the member detail line is memberDetail() in adjustTree.helpers.js (mutated here). The lazy read of open units only is asserted by AdjustTreePage.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AdjustTreeSide: Presentational tab strip: the badge counts are attention.length and liveAdjustments() (mutated here), asserted by name in AdjustTreePanels.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AdjustmentsPan: Presentational log: the status pill is statusMeta() and the who/when line byLine() in adjustTree.helpers.js (mutated here). Undo / Redo / Follow / Remove call useAdjustTreeActions (mutated here); each route is asserted by AdjustTreePanels.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AttentionPanel: Presentational list: which fix is offered is actionAllowed() in adjustTree.helpers.js and what a fix writes is useAdjustTreeActions.attention(), both mutated here; reader vs editor is asserted by AdjustTreePage.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/UnitPanel.jsx: Presentational facts and the action buttons that open one form; the adjustments shown on a unit are adjustmentsForUnit() (mutated here), asserted on three units by AdjustTreePanels.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/UnitActionForm: Forms that build one adjustment body each from their fields plus withReason() (mutated here); every body is asserted field for field by AdjustTreePage.mount.test.jsx and AdjustTreePanels.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/SplitForm.jsx: Form: by attribute value in a tree of people, by picked members elsewhere (isPeopleTree(), mutated here). Both bodies, the value list per attribute and the disabled submit are asserted by AdjustTreePanels.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/ActionForm.jsx: Presentational frame shared by the unit forms: reason field, disabled submit while busy or invalid. The trimmed reason reaching the body is asserted by AdjustTreePage.mount.test.jsx ('Reorg').
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/GroupBar.jsx: Presentational: the shared parent is commonParentId() (mutated here); the add-then-move sequence lives in useAdjustTree.groupUnits (mutated here), asserted by AdjustTreePage.mount.test.jsx and useAdjustTree.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/adjustTree/AdjustTreeActi: Presentational menu item and button over useTreeResolve (mutated here): enabled, disabled with the reason, or absent, each asserted by AdjustTreeAction.mount.test.jsx and ContextsPage.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/contexts/NewContextSchema: Form controls of the plugin parameter form: the enum labels come from enumOptions() in NewContextWizard.helpers.js; the values each control stores (enum by position, (not set) as undefined, ids of picked people) are asserted by NewContextSchemaForm.mount.test.jsx.
